args:
Implement flat-lay Looks Inspiration that displays recommended fashion items from OOTDay Stylist chat session.

  EXPECTED RESULT: When OOTDay Stylist recommends an outfit (e.g., 'Dress และ Leather Oxford Shoes'), the Looks Inspiration should generate a flat-lay image showing those EXACT recommended items individually placed and separated on a white background. Users can view all recommended items in the total look before clicking 'ดูลุค' for item details.

  EXAMPLE FLOW:
  1. User asks: 'อยากได้ชุดไปทำงาน' (I want work outfit)
  2. OOTDay Stylist recommends: Dress + Leather Oxford Shoes (3 ชิ้น, ฿6,670)
  3. System generates flat-lay image showing the recommended dress, shoes, and accessories laid out separately
  4. User sees complete look visualization before clicking for purchase details

  CURRENT STATE:
  - apps/web/components/chat/LooksInspiration.tsx uses 3:4 portrait aspect ratio for model photos
  - apps/web/lib/services/image-generation-service.ts defaults to 'full-body model shoot' composition
  - data/personas/prompt_gen/looks.md specifies: 'Put it as an accurate flat-lay image with each item individually placed and separated, styled in an elegant composition on a white background.'

  REQUIREMENTS:
  1. Create generateFlatLayImage() method in image-generation-service.ts that:
     - Takes array of recommended product items (name, category, color) from chat recommendation
     - Builds prompt using looks.md format: 'accurate flat-lay image with each item individually placed and separated'
     - Lists each recommended item explicitly in the prompt for accurate generation

  2. Update LooksInspiration.tsx:
     - Change aspect ratio from 3:4 to 1:1 (square) for flat-lay display
     - Add 'LOOKs' header with 'Outfit Inspiration by OOTDay' subtitle
     - Accept recommendedItems prop to display item count

  3. Update ChatAssistant.tsx integration:
     - After outfit recommendation message, extract recommended product items
     - Pass recommended items to flat-lay image generation
     - Display LooksInspiration with generated flat-lay showing those specific items

  4. Prompt template for flat-lay generation:
     'Generate an accurate flat-lay fashion image with the following items individually placed and separated, styled in an elegant composition on a white background:
     - [Item 1: e.g., Navy blue button-front dress]
     - [Item 2: e.g., Black leather oxford shoes]
     - [Item 3: e.g., Brown leather handbag]
     Each item should be clearly visible and properly sized relative to each other.'

  FILES TO MODIFY:
  - apps/web/lib/services/image-generation-service.ts (add generateFlatLayImage method)
  - apps/web/components/chat/LooksInspiration.tsx (layout + props)
  - apps/web/components/chat/ChatAssistant.tsx (integration)
  - apps/web/lib/types/image-types.ts (FlatLayRequest type)
